messages:
Priya (VendorOps): FYI OptiHealth (acct OPT-442) says their bank flagged a $12,500 partner invoice payment as duplicate and put a hold. They attached the ACH remittance showing two identical debits.

Jesse (Finance): can you drop the invoice and payment ids? need charge ids to build dispute evidence and to reconcile GL.

Priya (VendorOps): INV-PART-2026-06-02-77, payment: pay_ACH_8899 and pay_ACH_8899_dup (timestamps 2026-06-02T09:05Z and 2026-06-02T09:07Z). bank reference shows same trace number. customer insists they only initiated once.

Olga (BillingOps): marking account on temporary billing hold and starting reconciliation. billing-bot: please pull payment hooks.

billing-bot: webhook: ach.payment.completed pay_ACH_8899 at 2026-06-02T09:05:12Z; ach.payment.completed pay_ACH_8899_dup at 2026-06-02T09:07:30Z

Jesse (Finance): likely a connector retry produced a duplicate settlement from our payments partner. we need: settlement batches, payout ids, and partner-side idempotency logs. Priya, ask partner ops for their gateway trace.

Priya (VendorOps): pinged partner OPS. they replied: gateway shows a client retry after 120s with same payload due to ack timeout, and both settled on their end. partner advised we can refund duplicate and issue a memo to bank explaining duplicate settlement. attaching partner trace id gw-trace-55.

Olga (BillingOps): building evidence packet EP-2026-06-02-09. contents: invoice pdf, ACH remittance, partner trace gw-trace-55, webhook logs, payout id pt_20260602_77. recommending refund of pay_ACH_8899_dup and create accounting reversal entries.

Jesse (Finance): approve refund and GL reversal. please include memo for auditors: "Duplicate ACH settlement caused by partner ack timeout and client retry; refund issued to avoid customer dispute." Also tag for 30-day chargeback watch.

billing-bot: refund created rf_ACH_55 for pay_ACH_8899_dup (status: pending)

Olga (BillingOps): refund succeeded rf_ACH_55 (status: succeeded). EP-2026-06-02-09 uploaded. marked invoice INV-PART-2026-06-02-77 as adjusted and closed hold.

Priya (VendorOps): customer confirmed receipt of refund and asked for partner contact so they can query their bank. shared partner ops email. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
